notes:
- Fixed RDP graphics negotiation to properly verify confirmed server capabilities before activating AVC/H.264 mode, automatically falling back to Progressive CPU graphics when unsupported.

- Improved graphics flow control and frame acknowledgment timing during active screen updates, reducing input latency in embedded Remote Desktop sessions.

- Fixed an issue where creating a nested environment with intermediate paths (e.g. creating main/parent/child under main) did not properly create the intermediate parent folders, and enabled assigning or dragging machines directly into them.

- Added an Animations setting in Settings → General allowing interface animations to be disabled or customized independently of operating system preferences.
